description.value: A full-service private campground on Highway 99 just south of Lillooet, set near the Fraser River with dramatic mountain views; tent sites run $35–40/night depending on season, with hot showers, flush toilets, and playground on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity evidence. Potable water, hot showers, flush toilets, and online booking are explicitly listed on the front page and About/Rates subpages. OSM tags confirm free WiFi (internet_access=yes, internet_access:fee=no), corroborated by the website ('Free Wifi located at office'). Phone number and address are absent from OSM but clearly stated in the website footer, so these are sourced from the website only.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number or address; both were sourced solely from the website footer and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
Website copyright reads '© 2035 by Cedar & Spruce Consulting Ltd.' — almost certainly a Wix Studio template artifact, but worth noting as an anomaly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A fully operational, amenity-rich campground on Highway 99 near Lillooet with showers, potable water, free WiFi, and online reservations — a strong fit for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: hot showers, flush toilets … Free Wifi located at office
